newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Industrial Laundry Group says plans IPO.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Industrial Laundry Group says plans IPO.

text.p: Belgian industrial laundry equipment manufacturer Industrial Laundry Group NV (ILG) said on Wednesday it planned a pre-summer initial public offering on the Brussels Stock Exchange.
"The bourse offers the company the possibility of gaining access to capital in order to pursue growth in a blanced way," ILG said in a statement.
Both new and existing shares would be sold during the IPO, the company said.
Officials at the company and lead managers Generale de Banque were not immediately available to add details.
ILG sells its washing machines, dryers and presses worldwide under the Ipso, D'Hooge and Cissell brandnames.
The company said it had 1996 net profit of 141 million Belgian francs on sales of 2.5 billion francs.
